 Israel Police to Review Own Conduct After Election Day Arrests of Arab Activists
 Israel's deputy police chief will submit a report within a week after reviewing the arrest and investigation of United Arab List activists accused of election fraud based on allegations made by a former Netanyahu staffer

 Subscribe Josh Breiner Follow 01:23 PM • November 16 2026 IST Israel Police announced Monday that they would review their conduct on Election Day, including the decisions that led to the investigation of United Arab List activists, amid reports that a former employee of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office was the source of allegations that Arab party activists were involved in election fraud.
